title: pcapng: align with updates to the specification
description:
Changes in no particular order:
- Sort options along order in pcapng specification.
- Use defines from wiretap (which align with pcapng) in file dissector.
- Add handling of new block types, options and option values.

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 2b5429d8 - pcapng: align with updates to the specification
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19636/diffs?diff_id=1333574305&start_sha=96bb3bb13a2a9d1071e9f0028f6d873029c7920a)

I could only find the new TZNAME entry in https://github.com/IETF-OPSAWG-WG/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcap/blob/master/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng.md

Is there a better link we could add to the file headers for the current state of the spec / block-types ?
Well, file-pcapng.c points to https://github.com/pcapng/pcapng, which is as good as it's going to get as legitimate source.

> I could only find the new TZNAME entry in https://github.com/IETF-OPSAWG-WG/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcap/blob/master/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng.md

[The truth is out there.](https://github.com/IETF-OPSAWG-WG/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcap)

The "Individual Draft" link for [PCAP Next Generation (pcapng) Capture File Format](https://github.com/IETF-OPSAWG-WG/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcap?tab=readme-ov-file#pcap-next-generation-pcapng-capture-file-format) takes you to [the datatracker.ietf.org page for the current version of the I-D](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng). The current version is the -03 draft, which was issued on 2025-03-03, and mentions the `if_iana_tzname` option in [section 4.2 "Interface Description Block"](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng#name-interface-description-block).

The "Editor's Copy" link takes you to [a copy generated from the tip of the main branch as of the last checkin](https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng); that would contain any changes since the most recent draft was issued.

The "Compare Editor's Copy to Individual Draft" link takes you to [a diff between the two, generated by an author tool from author-tools.ietf.org](https://author-tools.ietf.org/api/iddiff?doc_1=draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng&url_2=https://IETF-OPSAWG-WG.github.io/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcap/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng.txt). At this point, the only difference is that it 1) has different dates, 2) lack page numbers in the table of contents, and 3) points to a newer version of draft-ietf-tls-keylogfile. The first is a result of the script that generated them giving dates based on the time the script was run, the second is probably a consequence of whatever adds the page numbers not having run, and the third may be a consequence of a newer draft having come out and the script finding it.

> Is there a better link we could add to the file headers for the current state of the spec / block-types ?

I'd point either to the I-D on datatools.ietf.org or to the Editor's Copy, for now. Either that, or just give the I-D number and, if, as, and when it comes out as an RFC, give the RFC number.

And, if any new block types or options get added, point to *their* I-Ds/RFCs.
Added a comment as such to file-pcapng.c
